findings.iris: All 26 hand-drawn capitals remain identifiable; G was corrected during development, and final full grids include a clear G. I/J have balanced open space, W uses reduced ribbon breadth. Larger flowers and attached leaf terminals integrate lettering with ornament.
findings.laurel: All 26 remain identifiable at 96 px. The final letter outline is 1.8 units with 3.2-unit foliage clearance; this increases contrast while retaining the delicate engraving. Broad W and narrow I/J retain distinct fitted proportions.
findings.briar: All 26 light capitals are true transparent cuts through dense foliage; B/D/O/P/Q/R counters remain filled by the botanical tapestry rather than turning into solid islands. I/J are visually centered; W stays within breathing margins.
findings.bounds: Every SVG has a minimum six-unit ink margin, verified by geometry and 96/112/120px raster alpha checks.
findings.transparency: Only a currentColor compound path remains. There are no alpha masks, white shapes, runtime fonts, external resources, or raster images. Light/dark test grids show correct recoloring and holes.
findings.optimization: Before/after raster comparison passed at every target size. No pixel alpha changed by more than 64/255; worst mean alpha error 2.04597/255.
